podcast.body: A duet from this 1970 song by The Stovall Sisters was sampled and used at the very end of the Beastie Boys' track "Intergalactic." "And that duets, right at the very end, comes from a 1970 song by the Stovalsisters called, Hang On In There."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
